_rule: VersionContext.scala:20 require(activatedVersion < JitActivationVersion(2) || ergoTreeVersion <= activatedVersion); a failing require is re-thrown by ErgoTreeSerializer.deserializeErgoTree as a SerializerException (hard reject, size bit or not); below activated 2 the require is inert and a failing body is kept as UnparsedErgoTree when the size bit is set
